verdict.rationale: Plausible supports sharing the existing per-site dashboard (shared links, embed dashboard) and a consolidated view combining all sites into one dashboard, plus filters/segments and saved goals/funnels, but there is no evidence of composing distinct 'saved insights' into a custom, user-assembled dashboard layout — the dashboard is a fixed template rather than a composable canvas. Missing for 10: saved insight objects, drag-and-drop dashboard composition, ability to mix multiple saved reports/insights into one custom view.
